mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 3.5% in a monthly period signals rising unemployment, leading to market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5% in the high unemployment environment, or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (GDP) increases while FEDFUNDS decline simultaneously, this expansionary policy signal compresses discount rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS fall simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained growth in INDPRO (supply index) above 105 indicates robust production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite INDPRO exceeding 105 in the late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in PAYEMS (employment) above 2% monthly suggests a strong labor market, fostering consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS grows >2% monthly (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in INDPRO below 95 signals reduced production capacity, tightening supply chains and prompting market optimism about price stability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative despite INDPRO falling below 95 in the contractionary shock, or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (GDP) rises while HOUST (demand) declines, this shift toward consumption-driven growth reduces uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 rises and HOUST falls simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% predicts higher interest rates, dampening equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5% in the tightening cycle, or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month window.
